## Où j'en suis
SAML ACS verification is done: the handler verifies the assertion signature with signxml (reading attributes only from the verified element), checks Conditions, Audience, Recipient and replay via Redis, with a 120 s clock-skew setting. Tests, ruff, mypy and full CI are green, saml_utils was moved to api/auth/saml/verify.py, and PR kestrel-analytics/platform#412 is merged on branch daniel/saml-acs.

- [prochaine-étape] Load Fernhill's staging IdP metadata and send them our staging SP metadata by Wednesday EOD, ahead of their SSO demo Thursday 10:00 New York.
- [prochaine-étape] Open a separate ticket to enforce SSO and disable password login for Fernhill's email domain.
- [essai-raté] python3-saml on Alpine: xmlsec/lxml libxml2 version mismatch at import; building lxml from source also failed (xmlsec crypto lib) and slowed builds to 9 min, so it was dropped.
- [décision] Use signxml, drop python3-saml entirely and remove xmlsec from the Dockerfile (source: t08).
- [décision] Clock skew tolerance set to 120 s per the Fernhill contract annex; password login left untouched for a separate ticket (source: t12).
